name: mouse (no button) steers to any angle: at 30° and 120° the target, heading and actual movement all point there (not a right angle); noindex preview
speed is 0.5 cell per step on a diagonal; the countdown ignores input; pointing on the player (dead zone) keeps the heading; the arrow key takes over and a still mouse does not grab it back
after being knocked out, “再玩一次” starts a fresh round (countdown, alive, tick 0)

touch: a tap turns at once (120°) without dragging; dragging keeps steering (−45°); a second finger cannot take over; lifting keeps the last direction; after touchcancel a new tap works (150°); only the board blocks page scrolling; hint shows the touch wording
360@3x / 768@2x / 1280@1x × zh/en × light/dark: pointing at −45° from the player gives −45° (relative to the drawn player, any DPR); no horizontal scroll
